g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: ProcureLake dev (ca-central-1): sources to Bronze, Silver and Gold

g.title: None.None.Node.26
g.text: Writes to the RDS PostgreSQL 17 source are captured by logical replication (dev/cdc, disposable)
The DMS full-load-and-CDC task reads the source with credentials from Secrets Manager
DMS writes immutable Parquet change files to raw/bronze/postgres_cdc/ through the S3 gateway endpoint
The apply-cdc Glue 5.1 job takes a DynamoDB lease, MERGEs changes into Silver Iceberg, then advances the checkpoint
make ingest-usaspending pulls one settled day and writes raw payload + manifest to Bronze as the ingestion role
The bronze-to-silver Glue job applies the latest complete snapshot batch; rejects go to raw/quarantine/
dbt-athena builds Gold Iceberg models and tests on the engineering workgroup; results land in artifacts/athena_results/
